report.summary: Checkout is failing in the last 5 minutes and the failure is visible at checkout itself: checkout spans oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder carry error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13 with otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (traces 141e26a4f12b8416fe5c23fffc8eba52, b4fd4fc3d6cc353deac5b383f40a6a7c, 859b1e48f2b51591aebf8881b1a4b380, bac230cc4154ef6926cbd5c7e4e2e19a, c0ec1203dba3bf41131212ddb38696c9). The failing dependency call is checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (rpc.grpc.status_code=2, same message), and payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is the deepest error observed: error=true with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace pointing at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13). Payment's only visible outbound span in those traces, grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat, returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0, so the evidence points at payment's own charge path rather than a dependency of payment. Checkout's other dependency calls in the same traces succeeded: oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (rpc.grpc.status_code=0, cart server spans and HGET/HMSET/EXPIRE without error tags), oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (otel.status_code=OK, rpc.grpc.status_code=0), oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (rpc.grpc.status_code=0) and oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (rpc.grpc.status_code=0, shipping HTTP 200). Email could not be assessed: the email trace search returned no_data (0 traces, 0 spans) and no email span appeared in any sampled checkout trace. Elevated latency could not be assessed: every metrics tool call returned status error/SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so no error-rate, latency-histogram or baseline series exist in this Run; in-trace durations are reported without any trend claim.

claims.text: In trace 141e26a4f12b8416fe5c23fffc8eba52 the checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (span 47e55dea736388a0, duration 35500 us) has status_tags error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; the same signature appears on checkout PlaceOrder spans in traces b4fd4fc3d6cc353deac5b383f40a6a7c (25100 us), 859b1e48f2b51591aebf8881b1a4b380 (21469 us), bac230cc4154ef6926cbd5c7e4e2e19a (20559 us) and c0ec1203dba3bf41131212ddb38696c9 (20251 us).

Checkout's outbound charge call is the failing dependency edge: service 'checkout' client spans named oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (e.g. spans 6f2f24be94fa6393, 70fa896dbe5da125, ef9b83b5286f53d0, e2b13b56442d098b, 0ee30519a3b23bce) report error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=2 and otel.status_description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', while checkout's client spans to oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote in the same traces report rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

The payment service's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries the error: spans a91475edc175bfd4, b86104e372a4dd40, feb2fbefc63948ec, ddaa2f16f1b970c4 and 298db30e157d2544 in traces 141e26a4f12b8416fe5c23fffc8eba52, b4fd4fc3d6cc353deac5b383f40a6a7c, c0ec1203dba3bf41131212ddb38696c9, bac230cc4154ef6926cbd5c7e4e2e19a and 859b1e48f2b51591aebf8881b1a4b380 each have status error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) at async Object.chargeServiceHandler [as charge] (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)'.

Impact is also visible on the request path above checkout in the same traces: frontend span 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' has error=true, http.status_code=500 and exception.message '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; frontend 'POST /api/checkout' and its parent 'POST' report http.status_code=500, as do frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' (http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR) and the load-generator 'POST' span (http.status_code=500).

Cart was checked and shows no failures in the sampled traces: cart server spans POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (3 rows, 309–803 us) and POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, plus Redis spans HGET (3 rows, 216–563 us), HMSET and EXPIRE, all have error_by_visible_tags=false with no error detail; the checkout-side client spans oteldemo.CartService/GetCart report rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

Currency was checked and shows no failures: 9 currency service spans named Currency/Convert carry otel.status_code=OK and rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations 279–1539 us, and the corresponding checkout client spans oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert show rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (9 rows, 811–3879 us).

Product-catalog was checked and shows no failures: 6 product-catalog service spans named oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations 33–117 us, and the 6 corresponding checkout client spans also report rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (244–857 us).

Shipping was checked and shows no failures: shipping service spans oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (3356–6030 us) and its child 'POST' spans report http.status_code 200 (3 rows, 3356–5724 us), with the related quote service spans POST /getquote and calculate-quote showing no error tags.

Observed durations in the sampled traces are small and are reported without any trend claim: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 20251–35500 us, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 2042–12987 us, payment internal 'charge' spans 452–10408 us, and checkout client calls to cart/currency/product-catalog/shipping all at or below 8834 us; no baseline, percentile or historical comparison for these operations was available in this Run.

The deepest supported cause is a rejection inside the payment service's own charge handler (charge.js:37), which returns gRPC code Unknown/2 with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.'; checkout wraps that as gRPC 13 (INTERNAL) and fails PlaceOrder, which frontend surfaces as HTTP 500. Support: payment's error span is a server span whose stack points at charge(), and the only outbound span visible beneath it in trace 141e26a4f12b8416fe5c23fffc8eba52 is grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat with rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

Cart, currency, product-catalog or shipping being the failing dependency was considered and rejected: their own server spans and checkout's client spans to them all returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 / otel.status_code=OK / HTTP 200 in the traces where checkout failed on payment, so none of them shows failure evidence tied to this incident.

A shared latency slowdown as the trigger was considered but is not supported: no latency series or baseline could be read (all metrics calls returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), the sampled failing requests completed in roughly 20–36 ms at frontend/checkout, and the failing call is an explicit error return from payment rather than a timeout or deadline-exceeded status.

gaps: Prometheus was unavailable for the whole Run: get_label_values, get_metric_names and three metrics_range_query calls (including a minimal up{job=~".+"}) all returned status=error, reason=SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE for target m0-otel-20260909. No traces_span_metrics_calls_total error rate, no rpc_client_duration_milliseconds or rpc_server_duration_milliseconds latency distribution, and no baseline exist here; error-rate and latency-trend questions are unanswered, not answered with zero.

Email could not be assessed: traces_search for service 'email' over the 5-minute window returned the view ded83bd8-5a4a-418c-ac28-e8cdda78e23c-t1:558c137b-855e-4b78-8fb8-bb76fca0291c with status no_data (0 traces, 0 spans), and no email span appeared in any sampled checkout trace, so whether email was called or failing during the window is unknown. No ShippingService/ShipOrder span was observed either, since PlaceOrder aborted at the charge step.

Trace coverage is a biased, incomplete sample: view 5c174d67-c9b9-44a2-ad16-2400d19da3ab-t0:36c2790c-6a59-4f6c-b0ac-e14116a9f50c is flagged incomplete (163 payment spans, 30-row slice read) and truncated; view d7b5e0f1-5a66-4276-af32-5ec46de51f2c-t0:c6a2fe35-0a9a-4a73-9430-fcd5637a2433 is flagged truncated (163 checkout spans, 45-row slice read); views 921b97f9-22be-45d2-a159-9f945fa92c4c-t0:a3293bbb-3d8d-4254-a8ad-5b8697def4c3 (cart, 54 spans, 3 traces) and 921b97f9-22be-45d2-a159-9f945fa92c4c-t1:7fa4a936-4b87-4a55-aadd-99add54fb248 (shipping, 93 spans, 3 traces) are flagged incomplete with reason 'backend returned as many traces as requested; more may exist'. Counts of failing PlaceOrder spans in a slice are not a call-weighted failure rate.

The trigger behind payment's 'Invalid token' rejection is unknown: the message mentions 'app.loyalty.level=gold' and payment made a grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat call that returned status 0, but no feature-flag definition, configuration or change history was queryable (change_history, pod_logs and kubernetes_state are not integrated in this Run), so fault-injection or configuration causation is unconfirmed.
next_steps: Ask a human to restore Prometheus access for target m0-otel-20260909 and then measure error ratios for traces_span_metrics_calls_total on checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, plus rpc_server_duration_milliseconds percentiles against a pre-incident baseline, before any latency-trend statement.

Have the payment service owners inspect the card-token validation path at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 and the token/card data supplied by the load generator, to confirm why 'Invalid token' is returned for these orders.

Check the OTel Demo flagd feature-flag configuration and recent change history for the payment charge path, since change_history, pod_logs and kubernetes_state integrations were not available in this Run.
Confirm whether the email step was ever reached in this window, e.g. by querying email traces over a wider window or with a working metrics source, since the email search returned no_data.
